transport.name: realtime
transport.pathSelection: x-fal-realtime.path (must match ^/[a-zA-Z0-9_/-]+$, no //) else /realtime for documented endpoints (fal-ai/fast-lcm-diffusion) else none
transport.inputSchema: x-fal-realtime.input_schema, else the bundled realtimeSchema.json for fal-ai/fast-lcm-diffusion when there is no override; a path-only override is refused
transport.wire: one binary MessagePack frame per input and per output; binary file content (bin) is returned as a data URI or stored-artifact URL plus { binary_base64 }
transport.events: SSE: `data: { artifacts, output }` per output; `event: error` with { error, status: FAILED | IDLE_TIMEOUT | SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN } before close
transport.limits: FAL_REALTIME_LIMITS: handshake 15 s, frame 32 MiB, send buffer 1 MiB, input 8 MiB, output high water 1 MiB, queued output 64 MiB, idle 120 s
transport.retries: none: no reconnect, no replay; an input without its output when the session ends is reported as SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN
